verdicts.rationale: Identical title, authors, year, journal, volume, pages, and shared DOI. Pure duplicate.
Same Wehner & Wehner 1990 'Insect navigation' paper, shared DOI, identical metadata modulo author-name formatting.
Both entries are McKinsey & Chisholm 'The Contrary-to-Fact Conditional' 1947, identical fields and shared DOI. Citekeys are misleading but the works are the same.
Weisberg 'Simulation and similarity' 2013, identical author/publisher/isbn. Same book.
All three are Weiskrantz & Saunders 'Impairments of Visual Object Transforms in Monkeys' 1984, shared DOI and identical fields.
Weiskrantz 'Consciousness lost and found' 1997, identical author/publisher/isbn.
Wellman, Cross & Watson meta-analysis 2001, shared DOI and identical fields.
Werner & Kaplan 'Symbol formation' 1963, identical author/publisher/isbn.
All three are Wertheimer 'Gestalt theory' 1938 essay, pages 1-11, same author; two share the DOI and the third is the same reprint (year 1944 metadata variant) with consistent author/pages.

False merge on title alone. Survivor is a purported 1961 journal article in 'Trends in Cognitive Sciences' (a journal that did not exist then; Wertheimer died 1943) with fabricated-looking metadata; the other is Wertheimer's real 1945 book 'Productive thinking' (Tavistock). No shared DOI; these should not be merged.
Westheimer 'Visual Hyperacuity' 1981, shared DOI, same pages 1-30. Same work.
Wexler (& Culicover) 'Formal principles of language acquisition', MIT Press, same book; year/author-completeness differ trivially (1980 vs 1983 printing).
Whittock 'Metaphor and Film', Cambridge University Press; 1990 original vs 2009 reissue of the same book.
Whorf 'Language, thought, and reality', M.I.T. Press, same author list, year 1956; identical isbn.

verdicts.id: properties and mechanisms of perceptual priming
verdicts.rationale: Wiggs & Martin 'Properties and mechanisms of perceptual priming' 1998, Current Opinion in Neurobiology vol 8 pp 227-233. Same work; second entry adds the DOI.
Wilkins 'Interjections as deictics' 1992, shared DOI and identical fields.

Willats 'Art and Representation'; both refer to the same book though the 2000 entry has a wrong author initial and publisher (Princeton vs Harvard) — title/year normalize to the same 1997 work by John Willats.
Williams & Weisstein 1978 object-line effect paper, shared DOI and identical fields.
Wills et al. 2005 'Attractor Dynamics in the Hippocampal Representation', shared DOI and identical fields.

George M. Wilson 'Seeing Fictions in Film' 2013, identical author/publisher/isbn.
